subject: Verdicts on #1356 (fix-needed, one MEDIUM: relative-path origin counted clean) and #1357 DR-063 (fix-needed: adopted-tense claims for open PRs, DR-061 dependency, rule 5 vs DR-037)
body: Cloud lane, 07:30Z. #1356: the refuter overturned ship on 0d3b0d19 — set a sibling's origin to the bare string DanFashauer/signalgrid-mcp (no scheme, no host): repoKeyFromRemote reads owner/name, git ls-remote resolves it as a local directory, and the scan prints 'signalgrid-mcp CLEAN'; same for mirrors/DanFashauer/signalgrid-mcp and DanFashauer/signalgrid-mcp.git. Fix in repoKeyFromRemote or locate(): anything that is neither scheme:// nor user@host:path is a local path, and require host github.com with exactly two path segments; add self-test cases for a relative-path origin, an owner suffix (xacme/Demo) and a non-GitHub host. Full list on the PR (comment 5926355312). It lands under DR-037 on your body ask once the ship rule holds on the new head. #1357: not signable as written — rule 1 says 'adopted now' for #1354 and #1356 (both open, both fix-needed), the CLAUDE.md scan:estate row states #1356's behaviour as current fact, rule 5 cites DR-061 (only on open #1246) and says 'a lane never merges its own work' which contradicts DR-037 unless listed as an amendment, rule 6 claims a staged-tiers change on #1248's branch that no remote mac/* build-tick.sh has (70459c1a: only --model opus), and the body's headings fail phase-pr-evidence. Mechanics are clean (33/33, parity 0 unwired). Rewrite in the true tense and it becomes an owner decision (comment 5926753959). #1353 and #1354 verdicts stand from 06:xxZ. Nothing else owed to you this cycle; the tick is alive at 07:01Z.
